changes.reason: Restore documented codegen --cwd behavior at the local Node child-process boundary. The catalog identifies this package as CLI Tooling with no deployed runtime claims; the change handles build-time arguments and output paths.

kubernetes.reason: Code generation runs in a Node build process before the Kubernetes Node Host application starts. Working-directory selection has no cluster resource, provider or application lifecycle contract.
constraints: Requires a Node CLI process with filesystem and child_process access during the build.

aws-lambda.reason: These wrappers generate artifacts before Lambda deployment. Directory selection belongs to the build process and does not participate in invocation scope, connection reuse or telemetry flush.
constraints: Run this code-generation command in a Node build environment before packaging the Lambda application.

cloudflare.reason: The CLI prepares artifacts in a Node build process before a Workers or Node Container deployment. This change selects the generator process directory without introducing an application Host path or runtime support claim.
constraints: The child-process CLI requires a Node build environment; Worker isolates do not provide this execution boundary.
